MOD = 1000000007

def add_modulo(a, b):
    a += b
    if a >= MOD:
        a -= MOD
    return a

def multiply_modulo(a, b):
    res = a * b
    if res >= MOD:
        res %= MOD
    return res

class Matrix:
    def __init__(self, N, M):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.mat = [[0] * M for _ in range(N)]
        
    def reset(self):
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                self.mat[i][j] = 0
                
    def make_identity(self):
        self.reset()
        for i in range(min(self.N, self.M)):
            self.mat[i][i] = 1
            
    def transpose(self):
        t = Matrix(self.M, self.N)
        t.reset()
        for i in range(self.M):
            for j in range(self.N):
                t.mat[i][j] = self.mat[j][i]
        return t
    
    def get_row(self, r):
        return self.mat[r]
    
    def add(self, other):
        res = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.mat[i][j] = add_modulo(self.mat[i][j], other.mat[i][j])
        return res
    
    def multiply_by(self, scalar):
        res = Matrix(self.N, self.M)
        for i in range(self.N):
            for j in range(self.M):
                res.mat[i][j] = multiply_modulo(self.mat[i][j], scalar)
        return res
    
def multiply(a, b):
    N, M = a.N, b.M
    out = Matrix(N, M)
    out.reset()
    for i in range(a.N):
        for j in range(a.M):
            if a.mat[i][j]:
                for k in range(b.M):
                    out.mat[i][k] = add_modulo(out.mat[i][k], multiply_modulo(a.mat[i][j], b.mat[j][k]))
    return out

    P[i - 1][0] = A[i - 1][0]

    A[i][0] = S[i - 1][0]

digits = []

s = 0
result.make_identity()

for i in range(len(digits) - 1, -1, -1):
